description: Elections Commission - P. J. Perera of the Kotikawatta, Mulleriyawa Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of the United National Party - I. R. M. Gamage of the Kotikawatta Mulleriyawa Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated her office of the member of the United National Party
reasoning: This gazette content is a notice under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their office as members of a Pradeshiya Sabha (local authority) due to ceasing membership in a political party. This directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local government, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
